Sam (Finance): Quick announcement: launching a virtual card pilot + team pooled budgets starting next month. Aim is to reduce PO churn and speed low-dollar purchases. TL;DR below.

Nina (Ops): Nice! TL;DR? :raised_hands:

Sam (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Pilot teams: Ops, Sales, Developer Relations. 2) Each pilot team gets a pooled monthly virtual card budget (Ops $8k, Sales $6k, DevRel $3k). 3) Auto-approve = purchases <= $250 and tagged with project code. 4) Anything > $250 requires a one-click approval from team lead in the portal. 5) Vendor onboarding unchanged for external vendors > $5k.

Diego (Sales): Does the pooled budget replace team POs for small spend? We do a lot of ad-hoc demo hardware purchases.

Sam (Finance): Yes for pilot scope: small ad-hoc purchases (shipping, demo peripherals, SaaS seats under $250) should use the team virtual card. For demo hardware > $250, still open a PO or request approval.

Priya (Finance Partner): Operational notes: a) All virtual card charges still need an expense memo with purpose and project code within 7 days. b) Receipts must be uploaded within 48 hours. c) Misuse will result in temporary revocation of the team card.

Nina (Ops): How do we tag project code? Is there a dropdown in the portal?

Sam (Finance): Yes 14 use the new purchase portal dropdown or include `proj:` in the description (e.g., proj:infra-2026). Auto-approve logic looks for either.

virtual-cards-bot: Virtual card created: team=ops, card_id=vc_ops_009; monthly_limit=$8000. Admins: @Nina, @Sam.

Diego (Sales): For international purchases, currency conversion fees? Are those included in the monthly cap?

Priya (Finance Partner): Good question. FX fees count against the cap. If you expect >5% in FX fees for a single purchase, mark the request and we'll review manually.

Sam (Finance): Pilot timeline: sign-up opens Mon 2026-04-05, cards live Mon 2026-04-12. We'll run the pilot for two months and share usage dashboards.

Diego (Sales): Is there a limit on number of card users per team?

Sam (Finance): Recommend 4 active card users per team. If you need more, request an exception with justification.

Nina (Ops): What about reconciling with team budgets in our monthly forecast?

Priya (Finance Partner): We'll export card spend to the weekly budget report. Sam and I will run a 20-min onboarding session for pilot leads next Tuesday 9am PT to show the portal and reconciliation steps.

Sam (Finance): Action items: 1) Pilot leads DM me to enroll (subject: "vc-pilot-enroll"). 2) Read the one-pager I'll post to #docs. 3) Attend onboarding if you're a pilot lead.

Diego (Sales): Enrolling @diego. Thanks. This should cut down on PO back-and-forth.

Sam (Finance): We'll monitor for misuse and tighten rules if needed. Thanks all 14 posting link + one-pager in a follow-up.

virtual-cards-bot: Reminder: please upload receipt for charge vc_ops_009_20260413_01 within 48h.
